about: Install manifest for Yihan's agent tooling. bootstrap.py applies it to a Mac (Claude Code, Codex, Homebrew, the daily updater); update_local.sh keeps it current. claude.ai and Cowork are configured in the web app and are listed here for the record. The reasoning for each entry lives in the AI Setup Registry in Notion.

skills_cli_existing.note: Installed earlier with npx skills for every detected agent; kept current by the daily updater.

directory: Raindrop.io (Raindrop; four bookmark skills on the raindrop connector, which claude.ai bound to the one he added by URL, so keep that connector)
claude_ai.note: Customize > Plugins > Add marketplace, then turn on Sync automatically for each; adding a marketplace installs nothing, and each plugin is installed on its own. impeccable and taste-skill update on their own (observed 8 Oct 2026). claude.ai refuses Sync automatically for a repository the Claude GitHub App cannot reach, and does not yet act on pushes to an account marketplace even when it allows it (anthropics/claude-code#93825), so yz-personal needs Check for updates; its pin job asks on a standing GitHub issue when pins move. Plugins listed in Anthropic's directory come from there (directory), which updates on its own. Plugins installed on the account also reach Claude Code as synced plugins, which is why claude_code.plugins lists only what the Mac installs locally. Anthropic directory and knowledge-work plugins are installed from the directory and update on their own.
